project_name: Groupe Havre d'Amour et de Paix inc. Website
mood: Warm, dignified, human, trustworthy, calming, organic. Avoid clinical or purely corporate aesthetics.

headings.notes: Use for H1 to H4. Expresses dignity, humanity, and warmth. Never use for dense body text.

body.notes: Highly accessible, clean, and modern. Ensures easy reading for older demographics.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs to create breathing room.

Devise Section: 'Accueillir avec amour...' in large elegant serif font.
Quick Services Grid: Hébergement, Répit de jour, Soins, Loisirs (Bento-style layout)
Intro Hero: Focus on holistic care
Photo Grid showcasing provided residence photos with subtle hover zooms.
Mission, Vision, and Values detailed layout.
Regional Presence Map/List (Montréal, Outaouais, Mauricie, Ottawa)
Donation Form: Custom UI for predefined amounts + custom amount input.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette to ensure warmth and approachability. Do NOT use default Tailwind blues or generic grays.
Typography hierarchy is crucial: Use Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body text. Ensure contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards.
Implement language toggles effectively without cluttered menus.
Ensure the Donation page relies on intuitive Shadcn forms (heavily styled to remove the 'tech/SaaS' look).
Use organic spacing. Avoid tight borders. Use the provided images extensively to establish trust.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Rely on the provided media list.
Ensure the header navigation is sticky and clear on both desktop and mobile.
Use `.js` files (not `.tsx`) for all React components.
